summary: Backend regression + hardening tests for the patched GET /api/files listing endpoint on the preview env (https://morocco-trips-2.preview.emergentagent.com). 14/14 pytest cases passed in 1.89s. Endpoint returns valid JSON 200 with the expected envelope {items,total,has_more,limit,skip}, items are metadata-only (no raw bytes/base64/content fields), pagination works (skip moves the page, has_more honoured), limit is capped to 200 (request ?limit=1000 echoes limit=200 and returns 200 items out of total=4228), limit floors to >=1 (request ?limit=0 echoes limit=60), negative skip/limit are normalised, q-search (?q=pexels, 500-char q, regex specials .*[(?)) and tag filter all return 200 JSON without crashing. Default call responded in ~160ms (<5s). Regression for the image-serving route GET /api/files/{storage_path} and the optimised variant ?w=960 both still serve image/* bytes with HTTP 200.
critical_code_review_comments: list_files (server.py ~2469) correctly wraps the whole flow in try/except and returns a safe envelope on failure — good. The metadata-only projection enumerates exactly the fields the contract requires; no raw bytes can leak.

max_time_ms(8000) on the cursor + count_documents(..., maxTimeMS=4000) with fallback to a lower-bound estimate is the right pattern to avoid gateway 520s. Verified empirically with ~4228 docs that the index-backed sort is fast (~160ms).

Minor (non-blocking): tag value is stored as a list but query uses an equality match on `tags` (Mongo handles array-contains semantics on equality, so this is fine). Slot_id filter uses substring regex via q — acceptable since q-input is regex-escaped and capped at 80 chars before .escape, preventing ReDoS.

The error branch swallows the exception via logger.exception and returns 200 with an 'error' field; this is the desired UX for the CMS picker but does mask 5xx in monitoring — consider also incrementing a counter/metric so it stays observable in prod.
test_credentials: Not needed — GET /api/files listing is public.
seed_data_creation: None. db.files already has ~4228 docs in preview.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_files_listing.py. It covers the envelope shape, metadata-only contract, pagination/limit-capping, filter resilience (q, tag, long strings, regex specials) and the image-serving regression for GET /api/files/{storage_path} and ?w=960. Reads REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from env or /app/frontend/.env. Production-side Cloudflare 520 is out of scope — must be verified after redeploy.
rca of the issue: RCA confirmed against the patched code: previously the listing did an unindexed sort by created_at and an unbounded count_documents over ~4k+ docs, exceeding the gateway timeout under load and surfacing as Cloudflare 520. Fix adds the compound index (is_deleted, created_at desc) + storage_path index, a metadata-only projection, max_time_ms on both the cursor and the count, and a try/except envelope that always returns valid JSON. Empirically the listing now completes in ~160ms on ~4228 docs, limit is hard-capped to 200, and all weird-input cases (negative skip/limit, long q, regex meta-chars) return 200 JSON.
